project: OCTO Invention Lab / Leaf to Light
scope: non-load-bearing tabletop shade-screen prototype; no public installation
material_visual_assumption: bamboo-look laminated plywood; physical species, adhesive, kerf, density, tolerances, safety and sourcing not established

A.name: Straight-slat control
A.construction: Repeated vertical obround/capsule cutouts; adjusted to common aperture target; no false decorative structure

B.name: Leaf venation
B.construction: Symmetric central stem, tapered branching ribs, individually enclosed organic openings; preserve minimum webs and continuous load path within tabletop plane

C.name: Bamboo rhythm
C.construction: Repeated longitudinal slender members with alternating grouping and simple connecting ties; no loose islands

acceptance.solid_geometry: nonempty valid STEP solid(s), finite positive volume, no isolated scrap islands
acceptance.geometry: design stays inside 300x300x6 mm nominal envelope; min frame/web verified numerically
acceptance.visualization: GLB and CAD dimensions agree within approved tolerance; no silent Blender dimensional alterations
acceptance.comparison: 40 percent +/- 5 percentage points aperture target of same 264x264 inner field, or record inability to reach target and why
acceptance.rendering: matched front, side, rear and 3/4 views and controlled material A/B
acceptance.physical: not_required_for_digital_gate; separate explicit approval before making/fabricating a prototype

safety: reference artwork is not CAD evidence
no installs, purchases, deploys or public posting without separate approval
